name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

nodes.name: Split: One Job at a Time

values.content:
You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject if:
- Requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- Hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- Requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (e.g. fixed EST/PST/CET)

Keep if any of these is true:
- Says worldwide remote, work from anywhere, global remote, or APAC remote
- Allows international contractors
- Accepts people based anywhere
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement

Return ONLY valid JSON, no other text:
{"taiwan_eligible":"yes/no/unclear","reason":"short reason","location_risk":"low/medium/high","timezone_risk":"low/medium/high","contractor_possible":"yes/no/unclear","decision":"keep/reject/manual_check"}

Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to this job. Mention how Jerry can:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

Return only the cover letter text, no subject line, no JSON.

SETUP CHECKLIST:
1. Create Google Sheet named 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 sheets: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Applied, Rejected
2. Add Google Sheets OAuth2 credential → replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID
3. Add OpenAI API credential → replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID
4. Add Gmail OAuth2 credential → replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID
5. Add Telegram Bot credential + replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
6. Activate workflow — runs daily at 8:30 AM Taiwan time
